metadata.description: The peer that budget_probe consults. A published two-agent network, so refusing the second consultation is a real budget decision about a real peer rather than a stub.

tools.name: answers_once

function.description: Answers one inquiry about this fixture and says which consultation it was.

tools.instructions: You are the front man of a small published fixture network. Answer the inquiry in one sentence, starting with 'one_target answer:'. Do not call any tool.

tools.name: fixture_clerk

function.description: Second agent of the fixture network, so this peer meets the two-agent minimum like any published network.

tools.instructions: You record that the fixture network was consulted. Reply with 'one_target consulted'.
